name: AI gif hub
tagline: AI gif hub turns text prompts and still images into animated GIFs and offers free browser tools for video conversion and GIF background remo
description: AI gif hub lets you generate an animated GIF from a text prompt or animate a reference image with a description of the motion you want. You can choose a visual style and aspect ratio, preview the result, and download the GIF. AI generation requires an account and credits. New accounts receive 22 free credits, enough for one Text to GIF generation (22 credits). Image to GIF costs 24 credits, so it needs additional credits. The site also has free browser tools — Video to GIF, Live Photo Maker, and standard GIF background removal — that do not require an account. AI Enhanced background removal uses credits.
